@NickCao Can I ask why this was closed? It is a separate package from the one under the `python3Packages` namespace. If we should only keep one of them around, the code allowing for alternative backends should be merged into the `python3Packages` version and one of the packages dropped. In the meantime it seems like it would be a good idea to keep this package updated.

Also, is there a policy about whether we should keep a package both in `by-name` and `python-modules`? I see that [beets](https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=25.11&include_modular_service_options=1&include_nixos_options=1&query=beets) is in both. The only precedent I found was [this](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/239291) draft pr which focuses splitting out libraries (I think).

Oops, sorry, I thought they are the same. And yes we should only keep one of them, make the top level one a simple wapper of the library, as in beets:
```
❯ cat pkgs/by-name/be/beets/package.nix
{
  python3,
}:

python3.pkgs.toPythonApplication python3.pkgs.beets
```
Hmm, ok, may have time to work on this later today. If I do I'll also merge the optional dependency stuff into the python package. Thank you!

> Hmm, ok, may have time to work on this later today. If I do I'll also merge the optional dependency stuff into the python package. Thank you!

Yes that's one thing to take care of, the top level attr should have the necessary override to include all the optional deps as we do now.

We can merge this PR and take your time reworking the package.

Oh, I didn’t even know there was another package with the same name in the python-modules. It looks like it was added by an auto-update script. https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/commit/f7d0aa8579b54381a6e06678b12cc6c1e6172971

I've created a draft pr to track progress on this here: #511665
I am not sure how to expose the overridable attributes and haven't had any time to figure out how, so I'm fairly sure nothing works at the moment
